name: Devavrat Kapoor
real_life_parallel: Jaswant Singh (Minister of External Affairs 1998-2002; flew to Kandahar during IC-814 crisis)

biography.background: Minister of External Affairs during IC-814 hijacking crisis (1999). Representative of political leadership faced with no-win hostage scenario. Accompanied terrorists to Kandahar as part of exchange delegation.
biography.political_context: NDA government under Vajpayee; intense public pressure for hostage release; strategic cost of terrorist release not fully apparent at time
biography.film_1_role: Act 1 political context; IC-814 crisis decision-making; establishes terror infrastructure release consequences

faction.primary: Government of India (Ministry of External Affairs)

ic_814_crisis.decision: Exchange 3 terrorists (Masood Azhar, Omar Sheikh, Mushtaq Zargar) for 155 hostages
ic_814_crisis.consequences: Released terrorists founded JeM and continued operations; long-term security cost debate ongoing
ic_814_crisis.personal_role: Accompanied released terrorists to Kandahar; visible symbol of Indian capitulation
